name: digital-twin-lamps-panel
description: Industrial SCADA Digital Twin for the NB2 Residential Lamps Panel — real-time MQTT telemetry, 3D visualization, thermal simulation, and Cloudflare Pages deployment.
author: Jehad Majed — Prince Sattam bin Abdulaziz University

scripts.deploy: node tools/build-dist.cjs && npx wrangler pages deploy --project-name digital-twin-lamps-panel --branch digitaltwin
scripts.dev: node tools/build-dist.cjs && npx wrangler pages dev
scripts.deploy:preview: node tools/build-dist.cjs && npx wrangler pages deploy --project-name digital-twin-lamps-panel --branch preview
